flow.steps: MCP client sends initialize/tools/list/tools/call through stdio or configured HTTP; runtime selects serving transport and exposure policy; native or unified server validates tool arguments, selects an upstream route, parses data and returns typed content or structured ToolError. Unified mounting preserves native names and records skipped/deselected imports.
flow.read: Console entrypoint and connector modules; MCP_TRANSPORT/MCP_HTTP_* environment; MARKETPLACE_SOURCES; JSON-RPC arguments. No client configuration file is read by the server itself.
flow.write: JSON-RPC stdout for stdio or HTTP responses; stderr diagnostics. No application data file is written by mounting/introspection.
flow.handoff: DF-HTTP or DF-CDP then DF-PARSE. marketplace_sources describes loaded/static capabilities, not live source health; selfchecks remain operator-only.

flow.steps: Tool assembles validated public API/SSR request; connector pacing/cache and bounded HTTP read constrain traffic and body size. Shared GET helpers return status/text for connector classification. Ozon runs impersonated blocking HTTP in an allowlisted worker; some connectors implement their own transport and fallback policy. Lamoda cards try HTTP GraphQL first (tier 1); HTTP 200 skips CDP, while a non-200 response or httpx.TransportError triggers exactly one in-page GraphQL POST through operator Chrome over CDP (tier 2), reporting tier_used graphql_cdp on success. Dated reason: 2026-10-12 GraphQL over HTTPS returned a 307 loop. MPStats reads analytics with its optional token.
flow.read: Connector settings/environment and proxy configuration; upstream HTTPS response bytes; in-memory cache. MPSTATS_MP_AUTH is read from environment for the documented optional API exception.
flow.write: In-memory cache/pacer counters and stderr events; no shared HTTP cache file. Ozon worker communication uses process pipes; worker-tree cleanup is an OS side effect, not a marketplace write.
flow.handoff: Lamoda card non-200 or httpx.TransportError hands off once to DF-CDP for an in-page GraphQL POST; successful fallback sets tier_used graphql_cdp. Other refusals may trigger connector-specific CDP fallback, not universal fallback for every source. Shared budgeted helper enters its supplied limiter before retries only; preserve this observed behavior rather than infer first-attempt pacing.

flow.steps: Tool uses browser-fetch or rendered DOM/state appropriate to its connector; connect to operator Chrome, autostart only for loopback, acquire global/per-host navigation budget, create an owned target, navigate within host policy, evaluate the read/extractor, classify walls and return raw content. Use Playwright or raw-CDP fallback; cleanup closes the owned target unless an explicit handoff retains it. A Taobao search grid that is still rendering is re-read in the SAME owned page for a bounded while (no second navigation, no waiting on a login or CAPTCHA wall).
flow.read: CHROME_CDP_HOST/PORT, CHROME_BINARY, CHROME_SCRAPING_PROFILE and budget knobs; browser session through CDP; public marketplace page/API content. Application code does not open browser cookie databases.
flow.write: Autostart may create P-CHROME; Chrome itself owns profile/session storage. Browser tab/navigation/window state and in-memory budget diagnostics change; ordinary extraction/snapshots do not write page content or images to disk.
flow.handoff: AliExpress card reads use a search landing and an in-page card tab; WB_TRANSPORT=dom affects only WB search/cards. Authentication and anti-bot success are not verified by static inspection.

flow.steps: HTTP status/text or CDP payload enters source-specific JSON/SSR/DOM parser; tolerant aliases/coercion retain missing values as None, collect warnings and distinguish shape drift from transport refusal. Construct source response models/meta and serialize public MCP content; schema compaction changes advertised shape only, not the response model.
flow.read: Upstream payload in memory; source parser/shape-reference constants where implemented; model definitions. Shape-reference Python constants are code, not a runtime fixture file.
flow.write: Typed responses, warnings and metadata in memory; ToolError JSON and redacted diagnostics on failure. No parser output file is written by normal tool calls.

flow.steps: compare_prices validates source selection, fans out concurrently with asyncio.gather and a per-source wait_for ceiling, normalizes source-native results, deduplicates listings and returns partial SourceOutcome records. Rank usable everyday RUB prices only, retaining missing/native-currency offers without inventing exchange rates. Detsky Mir has card support but no text search; Cian/MPStats do not participate in goods-search comparison. compare_verify_offer re-reads a native card for price/stock/identity; decision_inspect exposes native card inspection via the separate five-tool decision profile.
flow.read: MARKETPLACE_SOURCES, COMPARE_SOURCE_TIMEOUT; installed source modules; in-memory upstream offers and selected product identifiers; identity/model definitions.
flow.write: CompareResponse, per-source warnings/failures and verification records in memory; stderr events; underlying DF-HTTP/DF-CDP side effects only.

flow.steps: When enabled, retain an owned challenge page in a bounded process-local lease keyed by exact client scope/operation/URL/CDP endpoint/profile (current_client_scope: the MCP session on handshake-era connections; the stdio process on sessionless 2026-07-28 stdio connections; none, so no retention, on sessionless HTTP or in-memory connections and outside a request); surface opaque handoff metadata, then repeat the same read after operator action without searching unrelated tabs or navigating anew. Keep immutable lifetime and idle bounds, content digest/resume notes and closure on expiry/shutdown. compare_browser_snapshot checks ownership/liveness and image-delivery policy before returning bounded viewport pixels or text guidance.
flow.read: CHROME_CHALLENGE_HANDOFF_* knobs, negotiated protocol era, transport and session identity, lease registry and owned page; client capability/vision policy. No credential or saved page-content file is read.
flow.write: In-memory leases/digests and owned browser state; image/text MCP content. No browser storage, extracted content or screenshots are persisted by the handoff registry.

flow.steps: marketplace-mcp doctor invokes selected native selfchecks sequentially and separately probes Chrome reachability; distinguish success, drift_detected and inconclusive. Exit 1 for drift, 2 for blocked/inconclusive and 0 for healthy checked sources; status-write failure is 3. diagnose_drift offers structural DOM/API diagnostics. Nightly/manual CI runs live-marked tests for WB, Detsky Mir and Yandex only; its exit-code summary does not turn blocked sources into verified health.
flow.read: CLI source arguments and --status-file path; source canary IDs/shape references and current upstream responses; Chrome endpoint; live test definitions. CI summary reads live.log and captured pytest exit code.
flow.write: Operator console health table; optional --status-file JSON via temporary file in target directory and atomic replacement. CI writes live.log and job summary/output. No status file is written by doctor without --status-file.

flow.source: scripts/check_versions.py; scripts/check_no_print.py; scripts/check_test_count.py; scripts/check_coverage_floor.py; .github/workflows/ci.yml; .github/workflows/release.yml; scripts/e2e_stdio_check.py; scripts/e2e_stdio_check_docker.py
flow.steps: Root version anchors the 84 current declarations and required mcp-core pins; CI declares lock/lint/types/stdout/provenance/schema/offline tests and 70-percent branch-coverage gates plus real stdio registration/version probes. Release checks tag/version, builds all 16 workspace packages, checks distribution count/version and attaches wheels/sdists to a GitHub Release, not PyPI. These are workflow definitions, not executed outcomes of this markup change.
flow.read: pyproject.toml, packages/*/pyproject.toml, packages/*/src/*/__init__.py and server.py; uv.lock; docker-compose.yml; docs/DEPLOYMENT.md; server.json; dsh/package.json; P-RELEASE notes; existing test/gate source.
flow.write: Gate diagnostics; CI coverage artifacts; dist/*.whl and dist/*.tar.gz during release build, plus uv's dist/.gitignore. Release upload is an external CI side effect; check_versions itself writes diagnostics only and never rewrites versions.

flow.steps: Offline contract projection pins mounted names/arguments/output structure while excluding prose; operational stdio probes initialize and list advertised tools with bounded child cleanup. mcp_wire reports estimated wire tokens and compares selected profiles to the stored 10-percent budget. Routing evaluations score committed evidence/collected answers offline rather than call models.
flow.read: P-WIRE; packages/marketplace-connector/tests/fixtures/public_contract.json; registered tool schemas; work/evals/model-routing-eval.json and work/evals/routing-cases-v1.json; supplied routing answer file/stdin.
flow.write: Probe diagnostics; optional mcp_wire --update-baseline replaces P-WIRE, --json-out writes report; explicit snapshot script regeneration replaces public_contract.json. Routing report/prompt files are written only when requested. Ordinary comparison/server tool calls do not update these artifacts.

flow.steps: Captured HTML/JSON and declared SHA-256 provenance feed offline parser/extractor assertions. Optional Node/jsdom executes actual extractor source over saved markup, without live Chrome; missing tooling can skip DOM assertions. Provenance gate verifies existing pinned pairs with raw/LF/CRLF normalization and reports stale exceptions.
flow.read: P-FIXTURES and declared hashes; extractor JavaScript in connector modules; Node/jsdom module resolution.
flow.write: Provenance diagnostics only; jsdom harness uses temporary runner.js and extract.js, cleaned up by its temporary-directory context. Neither gate nor ordinary offline fixture assertions recapture upstream pages or update provenance.
